title: Word count
hints: Create the result first with `counts := map[string]int{}` (or `make(map[string]int)`). Returning it untouched handles the empty input.
`strings.Fields(s)` returns a `[]string` of the words; range over it with `for _, w := range strings.Fields(s)`.
A missing key reads as `0`, so `counts[strings.ToLower(w)]++` both inserts and increments. Then `return counts`.
